name: Defect / Bug
purpose: Represent an independently identified software defect record, its affected version and environment scope, evidence, classification, triage, resolution and verified closure without owning work assignment, corrective change, test execution or incident lifecycle.

owns: affected product version and environment assertions
defect classification severity impact and priority assertions
defect state triage resolution verification and closure
typed defect-to-defect relations and append-only history
delegates: generic remediation work assignment and scheduling to WM-ACT-006
corrective software change lifecycle to WM-SFT-013
test specification execution result and evidence to WM-SFT-015
requirement and expected-behaviour identity to WM-REC-006
build release and tested-artifact identity and release ordering to WM-SFT-008
test-defect record mastership remains an explicit out-of-scope gap
excludes: software change authoring review build release or deployment
feature or enhancement requests without asserted deviation

relations.purpose: Resolve remediation tasks assignments and scheduling without inheriting Task identity.
Resolve the corrective software change and fixed-in versions.
Resolve test execution and verification evidence.
Resolve expected behaviour requirements and acceptance criteria.
Resolve exact affected and verified artifact identity, digest and release ordering.

operations.effect: Create a defect with source identity affected scope and evidence.
Classify confirm prioritize and assign remediation references.
Append affected not-affected fixed or under-investigation scope.
Record resolution code justification and corrective change references.
Record independent verification against an exact later subject digest.
Close only after resolution and required verification or justified non-fix disposition.

invariants.rule: Defect identity is issued by its existing system of record and is independent of title, severity, date or affected version.
A product Defect is created only from adjudicationClass product-defect with originating evidence and observed subject digest.
Test-defect, environment-failure, inconclusive and flaky adjudications never create a product Defect here.
Observed subject digest is immutable except by recorded correction and is the verification comparand.
Verification advances state only on a distinct subject digest ordered after the originating subject by WM-SFT-008; unresolved order records evidence without transition.
Flaky, inconclusive, environment-failure and test-defect evidence cannot verify or close a product Defect.
No correction or revision of test definition, oracle, tolerance, harness or adjudication advances, resolves, verifies or closes a product Defect.
Resolved is not verified; verified is not closed; task done and service restored imply neither.
Reopening retains prior resolution, verification and closure history by supersession.
One Defect may reference many result fragments; every link role remains fragment-scoped and independently governed.
Affected scope assertions identify exact subject digest and assertion time.
Severity and priority are separate revisioned assertions; CVSS never implies priority.
Non-fix dispositions require authority and justification and never masquerade as verified-fixed.
Embargoed disclosure requires embargo end and disclosure authority; redacted exports preserve reference integrity.
Duplicate records remain resolvable and point to a surviving record without deletion.
Test-defect mastership is out of scope and remains an explicit unallocated gap.

holds: Test-defect record mastership remains out of scope and unallocated.
Frozen-source pin and clause verification holds remain.
Canonical publication and live verification are held; no new runtime ID.

Defect.guard: product-defect adjudication and originating evidence recorded
later ordered distinct digest and qualifying evidence
